scenario: stuck inside a multi-story underground parking garage
part1_script: Automatic doors open for anything that walks up to them. They do not check for a pulse. You have 4 bottles of water and 2 energy bars. You barricaded the door with 17 cars. You have 90 minutes of flashlight battery left. The power just came back on. Elevators are moving. A zombie just stepped out of the elevator and is coming for you. Comment Part 2 if you want to see how you survive.
last_line: A zombie just stepped out of the elevator and is coming for you. Comment Part 2 if you want to see how you survive.
